mapper.select:
SELECT IRELNK_NO, SSYS_ID, SFLAG, SGUBUN_ID, ICATE_NO, ILAW_ID, IEXCL_LAW_ID, SINS_DT, DISPLAY_NAME FROM ( SELECT EL.IRELNK_NO, EL.SSYS_ID, EL.SFLAG, EL.SGUBUN_ID, EL.ICATE_NO, EL.ILAW_ID, EL.IEXCL_LAW_ID, EL.SINS_DT, NVL(CD.CODE_NM, EL.SGUBUN_ID) AS DISPLAY_NAME, 1 AS ORD FROM TB_REL_EXCL_LNK EL LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE CD ON CD.CODE_ID = 'SGUBUN' AND CD.CODE = EL.SGUBUN_ID WHERE EL.IEXCL_LAW_ID = #{exclLawId} AND EL.SFLAG = 'full_text_gubun' UNION ALL SELECT EL.IRELNK_NO, EL.SSYS_ID, EL.SFLAG, EL.SGUBUN_ID, EL.ICATE_NO, EL.ILAW_ID, EL.IEXCL_LAW_ID, EL.SINS_DT, GET_FULL_NAME_BY_CATE_NO('NONE', EL.ICATE_NO) AS DISPLAY_NAME, 2 AS ORD FROM TB_REL_EXCL_LNK EL WHERE EL.IEXCL_LAW_ID = #{exclLawId} AND EL.SFLAG = 'full_text_category' UNION ALL SELECT EL.IRELNK_NO, EL.SSYS_ID, EL.SFLAG, EL.SGUBUN_ID, EL.ICATE_NO, EL.ILAW_ID, EL.IEXCL_LAW_ID, EL.SINS_DT, NVL( (SELECT GET_FULL_NAME_BY_CATE_NO('NONE', P.ICATE_NO) || ' > ' || P.STITLE FROM TB_PROM P WHERE P.ILAW_ID = EL.ILAW_ID AND P.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y'), '(법령 ID=' || EL.ILAW_ID || ')' ) AS DISPLAY_NAME, 3 AS ORD FROM TB_REL_EXCL_LNK EL WHERE EL.IEXCL_LAW_ID = #{exclLawId} AND EL.SFLAG = 'full_text_leaf' ) X ORDER BY ORD, DISPLAY_NAME
LIMIT 1
SELECT IRELNK_NO, SSYS_ID, SFLAG, SGUBUN_ID, ICATE_NO, ILAW_ID, IEXCL_LAW_ID, SINS_DT, NULL AS DISPLAY_NAME FROM TB_REL_EXCL_LNK WHERE IRELNK_NO = #{relnkNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_REL_EXCL_LNK ( IRELNK_NO, SFLAG, SGUBUN_ID, ICATE_NO, ILAW_ID, IEXCL_LAW_ID, SINS_DT ) VALUES ( #{relnkNo}, #{flag}, #{gubunId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cateNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{lawId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{exclLawId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
